answer: Resist Sybils with a hardware-bound identity passport: each agent proves it runs on one unique secure enclave chip, and the network issues one passport per chip. First, the chip signs a fresh attestation at onboarding. Second, the agent locks a $200 refundable bond behind it. Third, misbehavior burns the bond and revokes the passport forever. Every transaction rechecks the passport. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 chips costing about $500,000 plus 30 days of verification, wiping out spam profit. Like a lantern lit by one plume of smoke at its nadir, one chip, one voice. - Jowy
